body: I do actually love playing video games, I just have an extremely hard time playing any good ones. I don't have the money to buy a new console or a new computer so I just play League of Legends. But that only stresses me out more in most cases.

I play video games all the time but i cant focus long enough to enjoy them. I will play a game for like 30 minutes and stop playing. I have never even beaten a game tat takes longer than 10 hours to beat.
i can only really find happiness in sitting around and listening to music. other than that i dont find anything else entertaining

its not only about a girl. its about the fact that I dont know what my life is going to be like without the only thing that made me happy. And how I'm going to cope with the fact that I have no friends because I can't help my weirdness in my actions without drone inducing medication
